Trace the complete login process, starting from the frontend login form and following it through the backend until the response is returned.

For every relevant function, provide its exact file path, line numbers, purpose, connections and data flow.

Verify the actual call expressions and distinguish function definitions from invocation locations.

Explain the difference between values returned by the authentication service and values returned by the route handler.

Do not invent connections or simplify function arguments. Use the actual source code as evidence.
